facts.quote: On February 5, 2024, Prudential Financial, Inc. (the “Company” or “we”) detected that, beginning February 4, 2024, a threat actor had gained unauthorized access to certain of our systems.
beginning February 4, 2024, a threat actor had gained unauthorized access to certain of our systems
With assistance from external cybersecurity experts, we immediately activated our cybersecurity incident response process to investigate, contain, and remediate the incident.
the threat actor, who we suspect to be a cybercrime group, accessed Company administrative and user data from certain information technology systems
facts.note: Stated as a suspicion, not a confirmed attribution; the value carries that hedge.

facts.value: Company administrative and user data; employee and contractor user accounts

We continue to investigate the extent of the incident, including whether the threat actor accessed any additional information or systems, to determine the impact of the incident.

summary: Prudential disclosed that a threat actor, suspected to be a cybercrime group, gained unauthorized access to certain systems beginning February 4, 2024 and detected February 5, accessing administrative and user data and a small share of employee and contractor accounts; no evidence of customer data being taken, no material operational impact, and financial materiality not yet determined.
